# goton
> Multi-chain launchpad for fixed-supply tokens on Robinhood Chain and Arc Network.

goton is the premier multi-chain launchpad for fixed-supply tokens. Explore new launches, create tokens, and trade with permanently locked liquidity or dynamic bonding curves across Robinhood Chain and Arc Network.

## Products & Features
- Explore newest token launches on Robinhood Chain and Arc Network
- Constant-Product bonding curve with automatic graduation to permanently locked liquidity
- Decentralized trading interface with live charts and real-time order books
- Built-in metadata storage pinned to IPFS

## Public Surfaces
- App / Explore: %APP_URL%/launchpad
- Create Token: %APP_URL%/launchpad/create
- Analytics: %APP_URL%/analytics
- Memestock Community Feed: %APP_URL%/memestock
- Documentation: %DOCS_URL%
- Robots: %APP_URL%/robots.txt
- Sitemap: %APP_URL%/sitemap.xml

## Supported Networks
- **Robinhood Chain** (Chain ID: 4663): Native gas ETH (18 decimals)
- **Arc Network** (Chain ID: 5042): Native gas USDC (18 decimals)
- Token Supply: Fixed 1,000,000,000 (18 decimals)
- Pool Fee: 1% (10000)
- Launch Fee: 0.0005 ETH (Robinhood) / 1 USDC (Arc)
